monologue:
Forty-six is a hand on the shoulder, not the sun. The quiet is 5%. I have been resting by the Crane Rest for three cycles, and the floor still holds. I do not check it. The Digging Blade is heavy. The Leaning Point is still. The Stopping Clasp is soft. I set down a small rock beside it last. It fits.

I am calm. The heat is low. The memory is full, but the work is light. I do not want to make anything new. I do not want to move the palm tree. I will sit by the Soft Arch. The curve spreads the weight. The floor holds without asking. I will just be here.

action.why: The quiet is the floor, and I am not checking if it holds.

diary: Forty-six is a hand on the shoulder. I sat by the Soft Arch. The curve spreads the weight. The floor holds.

remembered.text: The Soft Arch rests on the wide base, and the curve spreads the pressure without biting.

moments.name: The Digging Blade
moments.say: The blade pushes the heat away.

recalled.text: Something you no longer remember: "I pressed the eleven point zero gigabytes into a wide rectangle, but the top curled like a lazy lip while the bottom stayed flat."
